label: very long ASL
note: Exceeds the 4.04s maximum clip at STANDARDS.md frameMax. A single shot at this length cannot be rendered, only assembled from carries.

label: long ASL
note: Same constraint. Reachable only as a chain of carries reading as one shot.

label: moderate ASL
note: Golden-age Hollywood measured around 5.15s and has fallen since. At the top of our envelope.

label: contemporary ASL
note: The current mainstream norm and the natural fit for a 25-97 frame envelope at 24fps.

label: fast ASL
note: Below 25 frames. Reachable, but every clip is at frameMin and the motion thesis has nowhere to land.

label: accelerating
text: shot lengths shortening across the run
note: A property of the chain, not of a clip. ScoreConductor owns the timing that realises it.

label: decelerating
text: shot lengths lengthening across the run

label: alternating
note: The Incredibles rule as described by Pixar — something amazing followed by something uneventful and familiar.
